title: Analytics
description: Track revenue, orders, inventory, and cart activity.

help.title: About Analytics
help.overview: Analytics summarizes revenue, orders, products, stock, and carts for this company. It only reads existing records; nothing here changes an order, a product, or stock. Each card needs read access to the data behind it.

sections.title: The period
sections.body: Choose 7 days, 30 days, 90 days, or 1 year. Not every card follows it.
items: Revenue, order counts, average order value, tax, shipping, and top products follow the period.
The revenue chart shows paid revenue and paid orders per day for 7 and 30 days, per week for 90 days, and per month for a year.
Trend badges compare the period with the window of the same length just before it.
Stock and cart cards are the current picture and do not change with the period.

sections.title: Money and currency
sections.body: Amounts are never added up across currencies.
items: Revenue is paid orders in the period, net of the refunds recorded against them.
Figures are for one currency: the one you pick, or else the one with the most paid orders in the period. The currency control lists every currency that had sales.
Tax and shipping are totals of those same paid orders.

sections.title: Orders and products
items: Order status counts every non-deleted order placed in the period, paid or not.
Top products rank by line revenue in the chosen currency and period, using the title kept on the order line.
Product status is the current catalog split into draft, active, and archived.

sections.title: Stock and carts
items: Stock shows how many rows are low (available above zero but under the reorder point), how many are out of stock (nothing available), and the total units on hand.
Abandoned carts have items and have not been touched for more than an hour; active carts changed within the hour. Signed-in buyers get one reminder email for a cart left for a day.
Open Product orders, Products, or Inventory from a card to act on what it shows.

errorDescription: Something went wrong while fetching dashboard data.
noStatusData: No status counts for this period.
noTopProducts: No product sales for this period.

kpi.activeCartsDesc: Carts updated in the last hour
